objective: Deliberate operator command to the selected original player, without replay after uncertain delivery or reconnect
sourceBinding: Exact files fetched through GitHub, verified against their Git blob SHA before testing. Patched runtime and test blobs below equal the published blobs. This was not a whole-repository checkout test.

bug.before: One Play invocation produced POST /execute then POST /unexpected-player carrying the same deck 2 play on body; adapter returned executed:true.
bug.after: The existing transport rejects HTTP redirects, preventing automatic second requests or trusting another endpoint's playback state.

green.scope: Six preserved adapter tests plus eleven new real-HTTP/protocol tests: 301/302/303/307/308 no-retargeting, second-endpoint 307/308 rejection, redirected query rejection, direct deck-specific play/pause, and separate-process redirect/lost-response restart cases.

restartProof.boundary: Actual executeClaimedOnce/executeClaimedBatch and adapter with owned durable files, not full CLI/CMD startup

nextBoundary: Authorized installed original-player observation and native Windows outer-CMD startup remain unverified. Do not repeat completed merge or registry work.
